name: labs/charkster__lecroy
title: LeCroy oscilloscope (lecroy.lecroy)
intro: LeCroy oscilloscope (lecroy.lecroy), adapted from charkster/lecroy. It reads `trigger_source`, `trigger_type`, `analog_channels`, `digital_channels` and 1 more; sets `horizontal_scale`, `trigger_level`, `trigger_horizontal_offset`, `trigger_slope` and 1 more; runs `trigger`, `force`, `reset_instrument`, `measure` and 1 more. `trigger`: configure the edge trigger level, horizontal offset, slope and mode. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/charkster__lecroy --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/charkster__lecroy --backend fake --mcp
